text: There are many reviews saying that the doctor is not good. But today, I went to use the service myself on 23/10/2025 at around 12.00. The doctor spoke politely and gave very good advice. The nurse who took the medical history also spoke politely. Everyone at the counter was nice. Only the nurse in the doctor's room had a sour expression. The young lady spoke abruptly, which is probably more like her personal personality. The service fee is cheap. I have received services at private hospitals before. Each check-up was not less than 5,000 baht. But today, the ultrasound to check for tumors and to get medicine for cystitis cost 800 baht. For me, I give 5 stars.
The doctor provided excellent service, as did everyone at the clinic. The prices were very reasonable, and everyone was very kind. ❤️

text: I went for an ultrasound to check on my baby. They told me to lie down and wait. When I got there, they just squeezed some gel on me, and it dripped all over my pants and shirt, soaking everything. They didn't wipe it off at all. The doctor didn't say anything, just said, "This is the mouth, this is the head," that's it! They didn't tell me the expected weight or anything else. After the ultrasound, they told me to sit outside and wait to pay. They only gave me some flimsy paper and a printed film of the baby without any markings on which part of the baby was which, and told me to watch a video on Facebook. I spent 800 baht, and I regret it so much. The doctor and staff seemed very rushed. I understand it was almost closing time, but they should have provided better service. I paid for their service. Terrible experience. I wouldn't recommend it.

text: Good service, reasonable price, not as expensive as private hospitals. The ultrasound images are clear and you get many photos, including printed pictures.

Excellent service. Thanks to the translator on my phone, it was easy to explain the problem. There are a lot of people, so it's best to arrive right before they open.
We had an ultrasound (they gave us the photo), which was also a pleasant surprise. We were given medications right there after the appointment. The whole thing cost 800 dietary supplements.
Thank you so much.

The first ultrasound cost 1000.
Less than a month later, when I went to deposit more, I was charged another 2100. Each time I went, I was confused because when I asked other people who had deposited at the same time, the price varied so much.

The obstetrician here is excellent at internal examinations. The day I went, Dr. Chanakan was from Chonburi Hospital. She was quick, clear, and the price was reasonable. I was very impressed and highly recommend her. The ultrasound and antibiotics for 7 days cost 550 baht.

The person at the counter spoke rudely, didn't pay much attention to the patients, didn't smile, and even sent the test results to the wrong person, saying that I had this or that disease and was at risk. When I was shocked, he said he apologized, sending the results to the wrong person. When he sent the new results, he didn't explain anything, just said it was normal, that the test results were normal in every way, and that I was in good health. I felt like I wasted my money. The test results came out late, but the doctor spoke well and gave good advice, but the person at the counter was not good.

The female doctor gave excellent advice. However, the staff seemed unwilling to provide service. We registered at the clinic from the first month of pregnancy, and the service was consistently the same each time. We continued until the fourth month, and now we've switched to a new clinic. Most recently, when I called to inquire about a 4D ultrasound, the person who answered the phone sounded like they didn't want to answer the phone.

The ultrasound took only 2-3 minutes; I didn't even get to see my baby's face. I don't know why they were in such a hurry. I only get an ultrasound once a month, and I want to see my baby for longer. It's not worth the money I'm spending each time. The staff at the checkout counter were constantly on their phones. I had to ask permission to ask anything. I'm due in two months, so I'm just putting up with it to avoid wasting time and money changing clinics. 😣👎🏻

I usually go to my regular clinic, but it was closed that day, so I took my child to this clinic. The staff there were incredibly rude, as if we were getting free treatment. The male doctor seemed in a hurry to go home. If he didn't want to take the case, he should have said so. He asked about my child's symptoms, and before I could speak, he interrupted me, saying, "Just answer what the doctor asks." After examining my child, he said, "Oh, so you're in a hurry to go home, huh?" It's a male doctor. Go to a different clinic; the staff there are terrible.

Everything was great, except for one thing. The doctor seemed displeased when we asked questions or expressed concerns, which made us feel scared. We didn't dare ask any questions because we were afraid the doctor would get annoyed. We've been coming here for treatment many times, but today was very disappointing. Every time we have a problem, we always come here; this clinic is our first choice. The doctor told us to buy medicine at a pharmacy. If we wanted to buy it at a pharmacy, we would have done so a long time ago; we wouldn't waste our time coming to the clinic. My boyfriend just wanted to talk to the doctor, and the doctor sounded annoyed that we just wanted to know what we were confused about, that we had this problem or that problem. You just examined us and charged us for medicine; you didn't listen to the patient's reasons at all. I wish the doctor would listen to the patient's reasons, what symptoms they have, instead of just examining them and prescribing medicine without asking any questions about our condition. I understand there are many patients waiting in line, but we're not here for free; we're paying for our treatment. We're here because we trust this clinic, and we won't be coming back again. It's very upsetting.
I wish the doctor would speak more politely, not in a harsh, blunt tone.

My hands, feet, and face were swollen, and the clinic doctor said it was normal. But when I went to the hospital, the doctor there said I had preeclampsia and needed a C-section. Luckily, neither I nor my baby died. The clinic doctor's examination was very careless. One visit was enough. I strongly do not recommend them.
